status: Routed native CAD review candidate; not a fabrication or operation release

independent_electrical_copper_audit.scope: Assigned nets and actual native copper graph; no current-rating, impedance, return-path or timing qualification

returned_clock_data_geometry.scope: Summed native copper lengths, not propagation delays. The provisional <=100 ps delay spread is not demonstrated.

separate_inputs: J5 nominal original-LDO low-stage feed 3.3 V
power_review.VCCO: TPS7A2015PDBVR fixed nominal 1.5 V supplies all four module external banks; PG gates its EN and does not monitor ASIC rails
power_review.ADC_reference: R3 connects SYSMON_VREFP to separate GNDADC; GNDADC is not merged with DGND

unqualified_planning_envelopes.XEM: 12 V +/-5%; <=2 A provisional load, not an implemented trip
unqualified_planning_envelopes.VIO: 1-150 mA aggregate and <=55 C local ambient; load/idle/peaks and thermal unverified
unqualified_planning_envelopes.original_LDO_low_stages: <=200 mA continuous / guaranteed <=250 mA peak; external hardware limiting/startup validation required

power_review.implemented_protection_limits: No automatic powered-off bidirectional isolation, ASIC rail-valid/readiness monitor, ASIC current limiter, reverse/backfeed interlock or accepted stimulation/reset cutoff. Original high-stage supplies and AGND return require a separate accepted contract.

all_connector_contact_audit.meaning_of_NC: Reserved contacts are explicitly marked no-connect in the schematic; they are not unresolved intended routes.

model_policy.public_3D: Native board/pads/outer copper plus five original nominal socket envelopes; remaining component bodies omitted; carrier only

ASIC silicon electrical/data-valid/setup/hold limits and FPGA timing closure
Signal integrity, return paths and controlled-impedance process
